search.title: Car Search & Listing Monitoring
search.description: If you don't know yet, or aren't sure what you want to buy. Brand and model consulting from an expert perspective.
search.longDescription:
Hundreds or thousands of cars are available in the current used car market per model. Yet very few of them represent good value for money and truly reflect reality.
With my methods and experience, I search the used car market quickly and efficiently, helping to filter out unreliable sellers even before the inspection phase. This way, we don't waste money or time inspecting poor potential vehicles.

consulting.title: Pre-Purchase Consulting
consulting.description: Close monitoring of used car and other automotive portals. To find the best possible specimen for you.
consulting.longDescription:
If you want to get the best out of a given budget, after assessing your needs I'll recommend a suitable model for you.
My recommendations are based on facts and technical insights, supported and backed by experience. I suggest models with an objective and rational approach, and I can also help you select the right specimen.

about.title: Who is Palicar?
about.bio1: I'm Dániel Barla-Szabó, a car purchase expert and calibration engineer.
about.bio2: I've been passionate about vehicles and their technical solutions since childhood. I spend my free time developing my hobby car and on the race track.
about.bio3: After completing my mechanical technician diploma, I continued my studies at Széchenyi István University as a vehicle engineer, where I earned my bachelor's degree in internal combustion engines and my master's degree in electric vehicle drivetrains. Thanks to this, I have significant, up-to-date technical knowledge in both traditional combustion engines and electric vehicles.
about.bio4: I have in-depth knowledge of vehicle technical solutions, their complex understanding, and problem identification — essential for thorough car inspections.
about.bio5: Working in the automotive industry for five years and counting, I've gained extensive experience in automotive trends, manufacturer specifics, and their associated risks.
about.shortBio:
I'm Dániel Barla-Szabó, a car purchase expert.
I've been passionate about vehicles and their technical solutions since childhood. I spend my free time developing my hobby car and on the race track.
As a certified vehicle engineer, I have significant knowledge of vehicle technical solutions and their complex understanding. I completed my studies at Széchenyi István University, mastering expertise in both combustion and electric vehicles.
Working in the automotive industry for five years and counting, I've gained extensive experience in automotive trends, manufacturer specifics, and their associated risks.
